svg.title: The same pair as a red and cyan anaglyph: the left view in red, the right view in cyan, for red-cyan glasses
svg.desc: One frame. The square on the screen is drawn once, where red and cyan overlap, so it looks dark grey. The popped circle appears twice, its red copy to the right and its cyan copy to the left. The sunk triangle appears twice, its red copy to the left and its cyan copy to the right.
svg.text: Red and cyan, on any monitor
red: the left view, seen through the red filter
cyan: the right view, seen through the cyan filter
the same two views, mixed by colour instead of placed side by side
